title: Pooled 4h trend-volatility context taxonomy stability
hypothesis: A compact trend x volatility taxonomy with thresholds fitted only on the first 60% of the aligned 4h sample produces non-degenerate contexts and reasonably stable frequency/transition structure on later chronological validation and test segments.

split.test_access: single final evaluation after frozen spec

classifier.priority: SHOCK if volatility > Q99; otherwise classify volatility LOW/NORMAL/HIGH; then trend
classifier.trend: SIDEWAYS if abs(spread)<Q33; UP if spread>=Q33 and momentum20>0; DOWN if spread<=-Q33 and momentum20<0; TRANSITION otherwise
classifier.context_labels: UP_LOW, UP_NORMAL, UP_HIGH, DOWN_LOW, DOWN_NORMAL, DOWN_HIGH, SIDEWAYS_LOW, SIDEWAYS_NORMAL, SIDEWAYS_HIGH, TRANSITION_LOW, TRANSITION_NORMAL, TRANSITION_HIGH, SHOCK

metrics: context frequency per symbol and split
mean/median contiguous duration in bars and hours
train-validation and train-test frequency Pearson correlation

predeclared_stability_gates.interpretation: Descriptive taxonomy stability only; failure does not imply a trading strategy is rejected.

exclusions: first 100 bars per symbol for feature warmup
incomplete/forming candles are not present in canonical input
costs: Not applicable: no trades or execution simulation.
multiple_testing: Not applicable: one pre-registered descriptive taxonomy; no strategy parameter search.
limitations: 4h canonical data ends 2026-11-05T16:00Z; newer raw 4h deltas are not merged into canonical.
This is context discovery, not a strategy backtest, not target-probability calibration, and not OOS trade validation.
No funding/OI/taker features in this experiment.
